route_observations.bodyText: Settings Account Team Integrations Data & privacy Audit trail Data & privacy How Unauth handles merchant and customer data, retention, and compliance. Data scope Unauth processes order exports and Shopify sync data to support identity matching and claim review for your store. Cross-merchant signals are aggregated and anonymised before network comparison. Retention & deletion Audit runs and associated transaction data are retained according to your plan settings. Account deletion permanently removes audits, customer profiles, watchlist entries, and notes. Contact support if you need help removing data before closing your account. Audit logging User actions, claim decisions, evidence attachments, and exports are recorded in an append-only audit trail for compliance review.
